propNotes.Label: Visible action text. Use a short verb phrase that describes the result.
propNotes.Icon: Optional leading named icon; it supplements the label and never replaces the accessible name.
propNotes.Variant: Visual emphasis: filled for the primary action, outline for secondary actions, ghost or plain for low-emphasis toolbars.
propNotes.Tone: Semantic color intent. Use danger only for destructive actions and positive or warning only when that meaning is part of the action.
propNotes.Size: Control and hit-area size: small 28px, medium 36px, or large 44px.
propNotes.Enabled: When false, prevents invocation. Explain the unmet prerequisite in nearby text.
propNotes.Busy: When true, replaces the leading icon with activity, prevents invocation, and keeps the action label visible.

propNotes.Label: Required accessible action name; it is announced even when only the icon is visible.
propNotes.Icon: Required non-empty named icon rendered as the button's visible content.
propNotes.Variant: Visual emphasis around the icon; outline exposes the hit-area boundary most clearly.
propNotes.Tone: Semantic color intent; danger identifies a destructive icon action.
propNotes.Size: Square hit area: small 28px, medium 36px, or large 44px; icon optical size remains subordinate.

propNotes.Value: Current editable text. Change reports return the complete new string.
propNotes.Placeholder: Short input hint shown only while Value is empty; it is not a persistent label.
propNotes.Enabled: When false, prevents editing and focus-driven input.

propNotes.Checked: Controlled on/off state. Toggle reports return the requested boolean state.
propNotes.Selected: Legacy state alias read only when Checked is absent; prefer Checked for new code.
propNotes.Enabled: When false, prevents toggling. Explain the unmet prerequisite nearby.

propNotes.Label: Visible Checkbox caption and native click target; keep it specific to the choice.
propNotes.Selected: Legacy state alias read only when Checked is absent; prefer Checked for new code.
propNotes.Indeterminate: Partial-selection presentation. The producer resolves the next Toggle report to checked or unchecked.
propNotes.Enabled: When false, prevents toggling and focus-driven input.

propNotes.Value: Value of the selected choice; Change reports return the newly selected choice value.
propNotes.Choices: Ordered value and label pairs. Values are stable identities; labels are user-facing text.

props.name: Label
props.note: the node's caption

props.name: Detail
props.note: secondary text beside the label, or a tooltip where there is no room

props.name: Value
props.note: what a field holds or a display shows; numeric for a slider, a number entry and a rating

props.name: Placeholder
props.note: prompt shown by an empty field

props.name: Help
props.note: explanation revealed by a pointer

props.name: Icon
props.note: named icon

props.name: Tooltip
props.note: explanation revealed by a pointer

props.name: Uri
props.note: the address a link points at, or the file a picture or a video plays

props.name: Enabled
props.note: defaults to enabled when absent

props.name: Visible
props.note: defaults to visible when absent

props.name: Selected
props.note: read like Checked

props.name: Checked
props.note: for a check button, a toggle button or a switch

props.name: Indeterminate
props.note: partial selection state for a checkbox

props.name: Expanded
props.note: for an expander or a revealed panel

props.name: Busy
props.note: runs a spinner; defaults to busy when absent

props.name: Secret
props.note: hides typed text, and on a password entry withholds the peek icon

props.name: Destructive
props.note: marks an action as irreversible so automation requires confirmation

props.name: Monospace
props.note: for a text view; defaults to monospace when absent

props.name: Wrap
props.note: words onto further lines for text, whole children for a row or a column

props.name: Ellipsize
props.note: for a label

props.name: Variant
props.note: emphasis level

props.name: Tone
props.note: semantic weight

props.name: Scale
props.note: text size role

props.name: Size
props.note: semantic control size, independent of text scale

props.name: Color
props.note: a semantic color slot, never a literal color

props.name: Gap
props.note: space between children; only a Step length has a pixel size

props.name: Pad
props.note: a Length applies to all four sides; Edges names them separately

props.name: Grow
props.note: any value above zero expands the child on both axes

props.name: Width
props.note: an exact extent, or a floor and a ceiling

props.name: Height
props.note: an exact extent, or a floor and a ceiling

props.name: Align
props.note: placement along the main axis

props.name: Justify
props.note: placement along the cross axis

props.name: Columns
props.note: grid column count, or a table's declared column count; never below one

props.name: Span
props.note: grid columns this child occupies; never below one

props.name: RowSpan
props.note: grid rows this child occupies; never below one

props.name: Orientation
props.note: axis of a container, a splitter or a divider

props.name: Position
props.note: the divider position of a splitter, in pixels

props.name: Breakpoint
props.note: allocated width below which a Responsive splitter collapses its first child

props.name: Minimum
props.note: lower bound of a slider or a number entry

props.name: Maximum
props.note: upper bound of a slider or a number entry

props.name: Step
props.note: increment of a slider or a number entry

props.name: Fraction
props.note: progress or meter fill, clamped to nought through one

props.name: Schema
props.note: table columns: key, title, width as a Length, align, sortable, editable, importance, identity

props.name: Source
props.note: identity of the windowed row source backing a collection

props.name: RowHeight
props.note: row height of a windowed collection

props.name: Choices
props.note: ordered options of a model-backed choice control, each with a stable value and visible label

lengths.note: steps on the 4px spacing scale; higher steps clamp
expand to fill the available space

notes.values: A property's value shapes are the PropValue variants an adapter reads for it. Sending another shape is not an error; it is ignored.
notes.lengthEncoding: A Length is an externally tagged enum: {"Step": 2}, {"Chars": 20}, "Fill", "Content".
notes.logViewRetention: LogView Value patches append; renderers retain only the newest 4096 Unicode characters.
